import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/test_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/test_4.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/test_5.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/test_6.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/test_7.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/test_8.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/test_9.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/test_10.csv"
    ]

    # Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, dtype={'code': int, 'name': str})
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source DataFrames vertically (union all)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # According to the target schema and examples:
    # - Target schema: ['code': integer, 'name': string]
    # - The source schemas are already aligned with the target schema.
    # - The target has 1374 examples, which matches the sum of all source tuples (sum of counts: 216+125+130+38+77+146+210+15+199+168+50=1374)
    # So the transformation is basically union all source tables.

    # Remove duplicates if any (not explicitly required, but usually target examples are distinct)
    # However, the examples show repeated rows in sources, so we keep duplicates to match total count.
    # If deduplication is needed, uncomment the next line:
    # combined_df = combined_df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

    # Ensure correct data types
    combined_df['code'] = combined_df['code'].astype(int)
    combined_df['name'] = combined_df['name'].astype(str)

    # Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_58/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
